findings.evidence: EigenspaceRepresentation.lean:156 `private theorem rightRegularLp_apply ... := (rfl)`, used at :208 `rw [rightRegularLp_apply, Lp.ext_iff]` and :267 `rw [hy, coe_convolutionEigenspaceRep_apply, rightRegularLp_apply, convolutionCLM_compMeasurePreserving_mul_right, one_mul]`; :183 discharges the invariance goal `rightRegularLp 𝕜 G g v ∈ eigenspace` with the `Lp.compMeasurePreserving`-phrased Convolution.lean:550 by defeq, available only inside this module since `rightRegularLp` (:139) carries no `@[expose]`.
findings.fix: Add public interaction lemmas and use them in place of the private unfolding: `convolutionCLM_rightRegularLp (k) (f) (g x) : convolutionCLM k (rightRegularLp 𝕜 G g f) x = convolutionCLM k f (x * g)` and `rightRegularLp_toLp (F : C(G, 𝕜)) (g) : rightRegularLp 𝕜 G g (ContinuousMap.toLp 2 (haarProb G) 𝕜 F) = ContinuousMap.toLp 2 (haarProb G) 𝕜 (rightTranslate F g)` (the latter also shortens `rightRegularLp_eq_toLp_smul_rightTranslate`), plus a `rightRegularLp`-phrased restatement of eigenspace invariance for line 183.
findings.issue: `rightRegularLp`'s only public API is `coeFn_rightRegularLp` (an a.e. statement) and `isUnitary_rightRegularLp`. Every translation lemma in `Convolution.lean` is phrased in raw `Lp.compMeasurePreserving` form (`convolutionCLM_compMeasurePreserving_mul_right`, Convolution.lean:401; `convolutionOperator_compMeasurePreserving_mul_right`, :419; `compMeasurePreserving_mul_right_mem_eigenspace_convolutionOperator`, :550), and the only lemma bridging the new name to that form is `private rightRegularLp_apply` — the file itself must use it at lines 208 and 267, and line 183 relies on the unexposed body by defeq. A downstream consumer (the roadmap's isotypic `G×G` decomposition uses right translation explicitly) has neither the body nor a public lemma and must re-derive the identification from `Lp.ext_iff` plus `coeFn_rightRegularLp`. This is the "use the new API without unfolding" test failing.

summary: The surface is otherwise minimal and well annotated (bodies hidden, `(rfl)` idiom, correct `@[simp]`s), but the new public definition `rightRegularLp` has no public lemma connecting it to the operations it exists to interact with — the only bridge is the `private` unfolding lemma the file itself has to use twice.
